column.name: slot_no
column.remarks: 정류소 내 광고면 번호. 현재는 정류소당 1면이라 항상 1

column.name: status
column.remarks: 현재 예약 상태. reservation_consultation 은 변경 이력

column.name: hold_expires_at
column.remarks: 선점 만료 일시. 진행 중(PENDING/CONSULTING)일 때만 값이 있다

changeSet.sql: UPDATE reservation.reservation r SET status = COALESCE( (SELECT c.status FROM reservation.reservation_consultation c WHERE c.reservation_id = r.id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1), 'PENDING')
UPDATE reservation.reservation SET hold_expires_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '7 days' WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONSULTING')

changeSet.author: hig

preConditions.onFailMessage: 같은 정류소에 진행 중(PENDING/CONSULTING) 예약이 2건 이상 있습니다. 선점을 남길 1건만 두고 나머지를 종료 상태로 정리한 뒤 다시 배포하세요.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT stop_id, slot_no FROM reservation.reservation WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONSULTING') GROUP BY stop_id, slot_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_reservation_active_slot ON reservation.reservation (stop_id, slot_no) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONSULTING')
CREATE INDEX idx_reservation_member_active ON reservation.reservation (member_id) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONSULTING')
CREATE INDEX idx_reservation_hold_expires_at ON reservation.reservation (hold_expires_at) WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CONSULTING')

changeSet.author: hig

preConditions.onFailMessage: 같은 정류소에 기간이 겹치는 유효 계약(PENDING/ACTIVE)이 있거나 종료일이 시작일보다 빠른 계약이 있습니다. 데이터를 정리한 뒤 다시 배포하세요.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation.contract a JOIN reservation.contract b ON a.stop_id = b.stop_id AND a.id < b.id AND a.contract_start_date < b.contract_end_date AND b.contract_start_date < a.contract_end_date WHERE a.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND b.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation.contract WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE') AND contract_start_date > contract_end_date

column.name: slot_no
column.remarks: 정류소 내 광고면 번호. 현재는 정류소당 1면이라 항상 1

changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist WITH SCHEMA reservation

ALTER TABLE reservation.contract ADD CONSTRAINT ex_contract_slot_period EXCLUDE USING gist ( stop_id WITH =, slot_no WITH =, tstzrange(contract_start_date, contract_end_date, '[)') WITH && ) WHERE (status IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE reservation.contract DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ex_contract_slot_period
